"STEP 2 – CHARACTER CREATION SYSTEM

Create a fully functional 3D character creation screen for RAT COUTURE – THE FILTHY RUNWAY.

1. CHARACTER GENDER

At the beginning, the player must choose between:

- Male Rat Human
- Female Rat Human

Both options must use the same grotesque visual art direction but have distinct anatomical body models.

2. CHARACTER BODY TYPES

Provide the following selectable body types:

- Extremely skinny
- Fat and round
- Muscular
- Tall and skinny
- Short and deformed
- Hunched and crooked
- Obese
- Asymmetrical mutant body

The selected body type must visibly change the 3D character model.

3. FUR COLORS

Provide these fur color options:

- Dirty grey
- Dark brown
- Black
- Dirty white
- Yellowish beige
- Reddish brown
- Patchy mixed fur
- Almost hairless pink skin

Fur must have realistic individual strands, dirty patches and detailed textures.

4. FACE CUSTOMIZATION

Allow the player to select:

- Small eyes
- Huge bulging eyes
- Cross-eyed
- Droopy eyes
- Bloodshot eyes
- Large crooked front teeth
- Missing teeth
- Yellow rotten teeth
- Extremely large rat ears
- Torn ears
- Bent nose
- Bulbous nose
- Long rat snout
- Short deformed snout

Facial features must visibly change the 3D model.

5. RANDOM GROSS DETAILS

Add optional grotesque characteristics:

- Warts
- Pimples
- Scars
- Bald patches
- Dirty whiskers
- Skin blemishes
- Crooked jaw
- Uneven ears
- Missing fur patches

The player should be able to combine several details.

6. CHARACTER PREVIEW

Place a large, fully rendered 3D character in the center of the screen.

Requirements:

- Full-body view.
- Rotate character 360 degrees.
- Zoom in and out.
- Show front, side and back.
- Character updates immediately when customization options are selected.
- Dark industrial studio background.
- Dramatic dirty fashion photography lighting.

7. USER INTERFACE

Design a stylish underground fashion laboratory interface.

Use:

- Dark grey and black backgrounds.
- Dirty white typography.
- Acid green and toxic yellow accents.
- Industrial buttons.
- Distressed textures.
- Bold editorial typography.

The interface must remain easy to navigate.

8. RANDOM CHARACTER BUTTON

Add a button called \"CREATE RANDOM FREAK\".

When clicked, generate a completely random rat human using different combinations of:

- Gender
- Body type
- Fur color
- Facial features
- Grotesque details

Every generated character should look different.

9. CHARACTER NAME

Add a name input field.

The player can give their rat human a custom name.

10. CONFIRMATION

Add a large button:

\"ENTER THE FILTHY RUNWAY\"

When clicked:

- Save the complete character configuration.
- Save the character name.
- Preserve the selected 3D model.
- Proceed to the next game screen.

IMPORTANT:
This must be a functional character creation system, not a static mockup. All selections must work and visibly affect the character model. Maintain the established grotesque, dirty, photorealistic 3D art direction.

Do not build the next game systems yet. Focus exclusively on completing this character creator.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.
"

## Objective
- Implement "STEP 2 – CHARACTER CREATION SYSTEM" for the existing RAT COUTURE – THE FILTHY RUNWAY game (in `rat-couture/`): a fully functional 3D character creator (gender, 8 body types, 8 fur colors, face customization, combinable gross details, orbiting studio preview, random freak button, name field, "ENTER THE FILTHY RUNWAY" confirm that saves the config and passes the character into the match). Do not build further game systems.

## Requirements
- Functional system, not a mockup: every selection must visibly change the 3D model immediately.
- Preview: full-body, 360° rotate, zoom, front/side/back views, dark industrial studio background with dramatic dirty fashion-photography lighting (screenshot verification required per Agents.md).
- UI: dark grey/black, dirty white type, acid green/toxic yellow accents, industrial buttons, distressed textures, bebas/glitch editorial typography, easy navigation.
- Character config must persist into the game (player model + name carried into match rounds).

"STEP 2 – CHARACTER CREATION SYSTEM

Create a fully functional 3D character creation screen for RAT COUTURE – THE FILTHY RUNWAY.

1. CHARACTER GENDER

At the beginning, the player must choose between:

- Male Rat Human
- Female Rat Human

Both options must use the same grotesque visual art direction but have distinct anatomical body models.

2. CHARACTER BODY TYPES

Provide the following selectable body types:

- Extremely skinny
- Fat and round
- Muscular
- Tall and skinny
- Short and deformed
- Hunched and crooked
- Obese
- Asymmetrical mutant body

The selected body type must visibly change the 3D character model.

3. FUR COLORS

Provide these fur color options:

- Dirty grey
- Dark brown
- Black
- Dirty white
- Yellowish beige
- Reddish brown
- Patchy mixed fur
- Almost hairless pink skin

Fur must have realistic individual strands, dirty patches and detailed textures.

4. FACE CUSTOMIZATION

Allow the player to select:

- Small eyes
- Huge bulging eyes
- Cross-eyed
- Droopy eyes
- Bloodshot eyes
- Large crooked front teeth
- Missing teeth
- Yellow rotten teeth
- Extremely large rat ears
- Torn ears
- Bent nose
- Bulbous nose
- Long rat snout
- Short deformed snout

Facial features must visibly change the 3D model.

5. RANDOM GROSS DETAILS

Add optional grotesque characteristics:

- Warts
- Pimples
- Scars
- Bald patches
- Dirty whiskers
- Skin blemishes
- Crooked jaw
- Uneven ears
- Missing fur patches

The player should be able to combine several details.

6. CHARACTER PREVIEW

Place a large, fully rendered 3D character in the center of the screen.

Requirements:

- Full-body view.
- Rotate character 360 degrees.
- Zoom in and out.
- Show front, side and back.
- Character updates immediately when customization options are selected.
- Dark industrial studio background.
- Dramatic dirty fashion photography lighting.

7. USER INTERFACE

Design a stylish underground fashion laboratory interface.

Use:

- Dark grey and black backgrounds.
- Dirty white typography.
- Acid green and toxic yellow accents.
- Industrial buttons.
- Distressed textures.
- Bold editorial typography.

The interface must remain easy to navigate.

When clicked, generate a completely random rat human using different combinations of:

- Gender
- Body type
- Fur color
- Facial features
- Grotesque details

Every generated character should look different.

Add a name input field.

The player can give their rat human a custom name.

10. CONFIRMATION

Add a large button:

\"ENTER THE FILTHY RUNWAY\"

When clicked:

- Save the complete character configuration.
- Save the character name.
- Preserve the selected 3D model.
- Proceed to the next game screen.

IMPORTANT:
This must be a functional character creation system, not a static mockup. All selections must work and visibly affect the character model. Maintain the established grotesque, dirty, photorealistic 3D art direction.

Do not build the next game systems yet. Focus exclusively on completing this character creator.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.
